# kcore_volume (Resource)

Data volume (`kctl create volume`). Size changes call resize.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_volume" "data" {
  name          = "web-data"
  size_bytes    = 10737418240
  storage_class = "ceph"
  vm            = kcore_vm.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `size_bytes` (Number)

### Optional

- `encrypt` (Boolean)
- `from_snapshot` (String)
- `storage_class` (String)
- `vm` (String) VM to attach. The VM must be stopped.

### Read-Only

- `attach_state` (String)
- `backend_handle` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `id_internal` (String)
- `pool` (String)
